newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Nov unemployment rises to record 12.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: French Nov unemployment rises to record 12.7 pct.

text.p: French unemployment rose by 20,700 in November to a seasonally adjusted 3,121,500, the labour ministry said on Monday.
This rise brought the jobless rate, based on International Labour Organisation (ILO) criteria, which exclude jobseekers who did any work at all in the month, to a record 12.7 percent.
Economists had said they expected unemployment to continue rising, peaking around the second quarter of next year.
National statistics institute INSEE earlier this month forecast unemployment would reach 13 percent in the first half of next year.
The conservative government of Prime Minister Alain Juppe has been unable to bring down unemployment as weak economic growth hit job creation.
